{"summary":"Read-only PLAN review of the proposed narrow deterministic phone/email presence-witness module, based only on the supplied packet. The gap is real in the supplied data: exact-copy evidence only runs for quoted/exact directives (assessment-evidence-scope.ts:153-175, exact-copy-evidence.ts:108-121; call site delivery-assessment.ts:333-340). A plain presence directive ('the page must list the phone number') is not a quoted literal, so a grounded negative suggestion goes straight through. The plan fits the existing architecture: a new negative-only guard in the changes_suggested branch, placed after the server-rule fail priority (delivery-assessment.ts:276-278) and after business mismatch/unknown handling (295-304, 317-323), using the same evidenceNeed/withheldRisks publication mechanism as the existing page-scope guard (305-315, 403-405). Design hazards to fix before implementing: (1) the applicability predicate and the scope predicate must be one finite whole-clause grammar, otherwise 'must not list' or image-only 'show' clauses become absence witnesses; (2) 'explicit named page' and 'generic anypage' need a safe default when a file is missing or a page is not HTML; (3) the owner extraction must reuse exact-copy-evidence's bodyCopy uncertainty gates (scripts, templates, non-XHTML, inline handlers, linked-CSS content generation), not a fresh parse, or it contradicts the 'do not claim visibility' boundary; (4) mixed, qualified, runtime, negative and pronoun directives must be non-applicable (not 'unknown' that blankets every presence criterion); (5) the 'pure explicit directive' exact-copy reuse must exclude any presence-directive clause, or the new guard can override a previously established exact-copy absence. No tests were executed. The Cycl19 award comparison is not adjudicated: the packet contains no competing-capability evidence, so no overall superiority claim can be made.","findings":[{"severity":"P2","file":"lib/delivery-assessment.ts","line":305,"title":"Planned presence witness has no defined integration point or priority relative to existing exact-copy/page-scope guards","evidence":"Line 305 opens the only existing model-negative disposition branch: `if (item.status === \"changes_suggested\" && status === \"changes_suggested\") { const tagEvidence = universalTagCheck(...); if (tagEvidence.kind === \"unknown\" && tagEvidence.reason === \"unconfirmed_page_scope\" && businessEvidenceCheck(criterion.id).kind !== \"mismatch\") {...} }`. Immediately after, line 333 runs `exactCopyCheck(criterion)` and on `missing` sets changes_suggested with the exact-copy explanation. The plan says negative suggestions for 'applicable presence-only requirement with positive complete source witnesses' become insufficient_evidence, and that 'exact-copy negative contradiction can use existing present only if pure explicit directive', but it does not state where the new guard sits relative to lines 333-340. If inserted before the exact-copy block, a criterion that is both an explicit presence directive and a pure quoted exact directive would be downgraded even when the exact-copy guard independently established a `missing` literal; if inserted after, a pure exact-copy `missing` would keep the exact-copy explanation while a pure presence directive gets the presence explanation. The current exact-copy check treats 'present' as purely negative (`Presence leaves a model suggestion unchanged`, exact-copy-evidence.ts:106), so a model claim of 'number absent' is never checked against a present literal unless the criterion is an explicit exact directive.","reproduction":"Reasoning trace (unexecuted): criterion source 'The page content must list the shop telephone number.', criterion.title 'Original requirement 1', criterion.id 'coverage-1'. `exactCopyLiteral` (assessment-evidence-scope.ts:153) returns undefined, `sourceLiteralDirective`/`staticMarkupDirective` undefined, so `assessmentEvidenceScope` returns source_text via line 182. Universal tag/list checks do not apply (no tag/list directive). Line 333 `exactCopyCheck(criterion)` returns `{kind:'not_applicable'}`. A model item 'changes_suggested' with the

Phone: +61 3 9000 1234

owner citation is published unchanged. This matches the reported V3 reproduction and shows the guard is genuinely missing, not redundant with exact-copy.","suggestion":"Specify the insertion point explicitly, e.g. in the line-305 branch as `const presence = presenceWitnessCheck(criterion, files, savedBusinessSteps, related); if (presence.kind === 'applicable' && item.status === 'changes_suggested' && status === 'changes_suggested' && !businessMismatchOrUnknown && !exactCopyMissing) { status='insufficient_evidence'; need('source_ambiguity'); explanation = presenceExplanation(presence, quote.language); }`, evaluated after lines 333-340 so a genuine exact-copy/presence negative keeps changes_suggested. Add an acceptance test for the exact reproduction plus a test that a pure exact directive with a truly absent literal still yields changes_suggested."},{"severity":"P2","file":"lib/assessment-evidence-scope.ts","line":178,"title":"Plan's directive grammar is undefined; loose or overly strict matching either creates false downgrades or blankets whole criteria","evidence":"The supplied admission logic is bounded by finite regexes: SOURCE_CONTENT (line 15) admits `phone|telephone|contact number`, but admission alone is not a directive. POLICY_COPY_DIRECTIVE (line 29) is the pattern the plan should emulate: a whole-source anchored `^...$`-style grammar that requires an explicit directive verb (must|should|needs? to) + state|say|include|show|display|specify|mention|read, else the item stays unclassified (line 171) and unknown manual requirements stay insufficient/observation (178-181). The plan says 'finite whole-clause phone/email presence directives EN/ZH' and 'Missing/ambiguous/qualified/mixed/runtime directives notinvent semantic absence; no global blanket unknown', but does not define: (a) whether the directive must be the entire source body or a single sentence-clause in a multi-clause source; (b) which verbs count (only list/contain/include/show/display/states?); (c) whether a leading scope phrase ('On the contact page, ...') is part of the clause; (d) whether the title must repeat or is ignored; (e) how to reject source containing 'must not', 'if', 'when', 'please', 'could', 'should ideally', 'up to date', 'reachable', 'clickable', 'tel: link', 'call button', 'working', 'valid', 'active', or runtime terms (OBSERVATION_REQUIRED line 25). A clause-level match like `/phone|email/` + `/must|should/` would make 'The phone number must be clickable' applicable and then treat a present number as an 'absence contradiction', masking the genuine runtime/clickability defect.","reproduction":"Reasoning trace (unexecuted): source 'The phone number on the contact page must be a clickable tel: link.' If the clause matcher uses a verb list including 'must' and an object list including 'phone', it marks applicability and looks for a number owner. The owner '

Phone: +61 3 9000 1234

' is present (no tel: link), so the guard produces insufficient_evidence and withholds a model changes_suggested that correctly identifies a missing link. Conversely, if the grammar requires exactly 'must list the shop telephone number', the V3 reproduction itself ('must list the shop telephone number' - 'shop' is not an item named in SOURCE_CONTENT's list but is within the phone noun phrase) may not be admitted at all, and no improvement is observable.","suggestion":"Define the grammar in code as an anchored, whole-directive regex set analogous to POLICY_COPY_DIRECTIVE: EN `^(?:the )?page(?: content)? must (?:list|contain|include|show|display|state|provide) (?:the )?(?:shop|store|business|restaurant|company|clinic)? ?(?:telephone|phone)(?: number)?$` and `... (?:email|e-mail|contact email) address$`, plus ZH `^(?:页面|网站)(?:中|上)?(?:必须|须|需要|需|应)(?:列出|包含|展示|显示|写明|注明)(?:店铺|商店|餐厅|公司)?(?:电话|电话号码|电子邮箱|邮箱)(?:号码)?$`. Reject if the source contains any observation/runtime veto (reuse OBSERVATION_REQUIRED), any negation ('not list', 'no phone'), any qualifier ('ideally', 'if possible', 'up to date', '24/7', 'reachable', 'valid', 'active'), or any second verb requiring a different object. Add a negative-case table test for clickable/tel:-link, optional, working, 'must not display', and the exact V3 source so that the accept/reject boundary is frozen."},{"severity":"P2","file":"lib/exact-copy-evidence.ts","line":22,"title":"Page-scope admission is unspecified for absent files, role aliases, and non-HTML targets; wildcard and named scope need an explicit safe default","evidence":"`bodyCopy` (lines 20-64) takes a snapshot of all supplied HTML files and returns `{segments: [], uncertain: true}` if no HTML exists or total > 262,144 UTF16 (line 22). The plan's 'explicit namedpage scope otherwise generic anypage only (no role guessing)' leaves open: whether a named page that is not present in `files` yields 'not applicable' or 'present everywhere is false' (an absence conclusion), whether a named page that exists but is not .html yields the same, and whether any-page checking must require ALL html files to be parse-certain before claiming absence. `bodyCopy` already returns a single `uncertain` flag for the whole file set (line 23 includes CSS generated-content and CSS link problems), so a single uncertain file in the set makes every any-page witness `unknown`. The plan says 'no global blanket unknown' - that must not be achieved by dropping the uncertainty gate.","reproduction":"Reasoning trace (unexecuted): directive 'On contact.html the page must list the phone number' with files containing only index.html. If the implementation treats the missing named page as an empty body copy with `uncertain=false`, the witness concludes absence and correctly downgrades a model 'phone absent' claim to insufficient_evidence (good). But the same logic applied to a directive naming 'contact.html' that is delivered as an image-only bundle would conclude absence and mask a real missing page. Conversely, if a missing named page returns 'not applicable', a model claim of absence is published unchanged. The packet's fixture (tests/assessment-negative-page-scope.test.ts:17, 'menu.html' omitted when options.missing) shows exactly this split case in the existing page-scope guard.","suggestion":"Specify: (1) an 'any page' directive witnesses presence only over the set of supplied .html files and is insufficient_evidence only if every file parses with `uncertain=false`; a single uncertain file yields insufficient_evidence with source_ambiguity, never a model-unchanged pass-through; (2) a named page that is absent, non-.html, or in `coverage.omittedFiles` yields insufficient_evidence with page_scope (no absence conclusion); (3) role words such as homepage, contact page, footer are rejected by the grammar unless they are literal file paths matching an `.html` key. Add tests for each of these three cases."},{"severity":"P2","file":"lib/exact-copy-evidence.ts","line":40,"title":"Owner extraction must share the existing uncertainty gates; a parallel AST walk without them will contradict the 'never claim visibility' boundary","evidence":"`bodyCopy` already sets `uncertain` for: script tags with executable/non-JSON type (line 40), DYNAMIC_OR_UNSUPPORTED elements (line 41), inline `on*` handlers or `style` with `content:`/`@import`/backslash (line 42), `
